runner.observation_contract: two live uint8 224x224 RGB views, seven joint positions, one gripper position, and the frozen task prompt
runner.action_contract: 10x8 OpenPI DROID chunk with the first eight rows executed at 15 Hz
runner.camera_execution: fixed external plus hand-transform-derived wrist view recomputed before every policy query

development_history.reason_not_eligible: These runs changed control staging, waypoint height, or tracking assumptions after observing failures and are retained only as engineering diagnostics. They cannot be selected as policy-ranking evidence.

contradiction.interpretation: The scene and articulated robot are feasible, but the current eight-action 15 Hz DROID-to-MuJoCo low-level translation does not preserve the working grasp through lift. Camera validity and action-shape validity therefore do not establish controller fidelity.

decision.required_resolution: Integrate and attribute a faithful public DROID low-level controller or otherwise demonstrate that the unchanged scripted positive control passes the same frozen observation/action seam before any learned-policy ranking is accepted.
